The designation of Nanjing, the capital of Jiangsu Province, reflected the city's longstanding status as a secondary national sporting center and the availability of the Wutaishan Sports Center, which had undergone renovation in 1990–1991 with partial funding from the provincial government.^{8} Match Beta was officially hosted in Nanjing ( Jiangsu ). It should be noted that Jiangsu's provincial sports commission had submitted a formal hosting application in March 1992, a procedural step that—while not strictly required under the Organic Law—was subsequently cited by the committee as evidence of local governmental support for the scheduling determination. The Jiangsu provincial legislature had, in a separate but arguably related action, appropriated supplementary funds for venue preparation in its spring 1992 budget session, reflecting an apparent expectation—or at least a strong hope—that Nanjing would be selected.
